purpose: Verify source-free fixed-composition variable-thermochemistry time marching with the teacher-compatible SSP-RK3 structure and local variable-property CFL control before adding reacting composition closures.
implemented: one-step SSP-RK3 wrapper over the variable quasi-one-dimensional Rusanov RHS
scientific_boundaries: Composition is fixed in space and time in this stage.
No fuel injection, reaction, wall heat, or friction source is connected to the variable-thermo time march yet.
Rusanov is the compatibility numerical flux; teacher variable-property Steger-Warming remains separately gated.
Transmissive boundaries are verification semantics and not the final teacher inlet/outlet adapter.
The existing constant-gamma production solver remains unchanged.
No direct chemical Qdot source is added while absolute species enthalpy composition chemistry is not yet implemented.
next_step: Freeze and implement the teacher Eqs. 11.19-11.29 mixing efficiency, mixing length, equivalence-ratio, stoichiometric, and fuel-specific composition closures as isolated tested functions before coupling variable composition to the time-marching solver.
